test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

P – Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’,

P x Q means ‘P is the wife of Q’ and

P ÷ Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

Based on the above, how is U related to Z if ‘U – V + W ÷ Y x Z’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30c846b9ff2ba207e1d695af82791b28e53eb8feaafb87a71ff85ca49dd74512.png]

Given: U – V + W ÷ Y x Z’

U – V means U is brother of V

V + W means V is mother of W

W ÷ Y means W is father of Y

Y x Z means Y is wife of Z

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2952b295283e8a14221dc0b80a702963b4161f4d67f47b07d4af7be4bb15685.png] 

Thus, 'U' is Wife's Father's Mother's Brother of 'Z'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
